# backstage-plugin-quote-page

A Backstage plugin that displays random inspirational quotes using the Quotable API.

## Features

- Display random quotes with authors
- Refresh to get new quotes
- Beautiful Material-UI design
- Fast and lightweight

## Installation

1. Install the plugin in your Backstage app:

```bash
yarn add backstage-plugin-quote-page
```

2. Add the plugin to your app's `App.tsx`:

```typescript
import { QuotePagePage } from 'backstage-plugin-quote-page';

// In your routes:
<Route path="/quote-page" element={<QuotePagePage />} />
```

3. (Optional) Add a sidebar item in `Root.tsx`:

```typescript
import FormatQuoteIcon from '@material-ui/icons/FormatQuote';

// In your sidebar:
<SidebarItem icon={FormatQuoteIcon} to="quote-page" text="Random Quotes" />
```

## Development

To run the plugin in isolation for development:

```bash
yarn install
yarn start
```

## API

This plugin uses the [Quotable API](https://api.quotable.io) to fetch random quotes.
